name: FHE Feature Extraction
purpose: TenSEAL CKKS feature extraction: the input vector is encrypted and each feature is computed as a dot product on the ciphertext, so only derived feature values are decrypted. The threat model documents a split deployment in which the evaluator holds only public evaluation keys.

name: DP LLM Training
purpose: Privacy-accounting training wrapper: computes (ε, δ) for the configured noise multiplier, sampling rate, and step count, signals when the target budget is reached, and writes a per-epoch JSON audit log checked by a validator.

name: LLM Leakage Assessment
purpose: Seven-category threat taxonomy and structured assessment checklist covering prompt injection, training-data extraction, membership inference, system-prompt extraction, log capture, embedding inversion, and indirect injection.

name: Governance Templates
purpose: Data-minimization, access-control policy, derived-variable lineage, IRB-amendment, and pre-export review templates for institutions operating under HIPAA, GDPR Article 9, Sweden's Patientdatalag, and equivalent data-governance frameworks.
